description: Higgsfield-style camera + motion presets for generative video. Open video models take camera direction as natural language in the prompt, so a preset is a prompt fragment plus a few generation hints. `reliability` is how consistently the move actually shows up in the output: high = works nearly every time, medium = works most of the time, low = worth a reroll or two. `family` groups them for the picker UI.

push_in.label: Push In
push_in.prompt: the camera slowly pushes in toward the subject, steady controlled dolly, gradual tightening of the frame
push_in.notes: The safest move in the library. Reads as intentional on almost any subject.

pull_back.label: Pull Back
pull_back.prompt: the camera slowly pulls back away from the subject, revealing more of the surrounding environment
pull_back.notes: Reveal shot. Pairs well with a line that widens the argument.

crash_zoom_in.label: Crash Zoom In
crash_zoom_in.prompt: the camera crash zooms in fast and hard toward the subject, sudden aggressive snap push, motion blur streaking at the frame edges
crash_zoom_in.notes: Higgsfield's signature move. Punchy on a stinger word; needs a subject with a clear focal point or it just smears.

crash_zoom_out.label: Crash Zoom Out
crash_zoom_out.prompt: the camera crash zooms out fast and hard, sudden snap pull revealing the wider scene, motion blur streaking at the frame edges

dolly_in.label: Dolly In
dolly_in.prompt: the camera dollies forward through the scene at a steady pace, parallax between foreground and background as it moves
dolly_in.notes: Differs from push_in by moving THROUGH space — you get real parallax, not just a scale-up.

dolly_out.label: Dolly Out
dolly_out.prompt: the camera dollies backward through the scene at a steady pace, foreground elements sliding past, deep parallax

orbit_left.label: Orbit Left
orbit_left.prompt: the camera arcs smoothly around the subject to the left, orbiting shot, subject stays centered while the background sweeps past
orbit_left.notes: Wants a clearly separable subject. On flat/abstract frames it degenerates into a pan.

orbit_right.label: Orbit Right
orbit_right.prompt: the camera arcs smoothly around the subject to the right, orbiting shot, subject stays centered while the background sweeps past

crane_up.label: Crane Up
crane_up.prompt: the camera cranes upward and tilts down slightly, rising above the scene, revealing scale from a higher vantage

crane_down.label: Crane Down
crane_down.prompt: the camera cranes downward from above toward the subject, descending smoothly to eye level

tilt_up.label: Tilt Up
tilt_up.prompt: the camera tilts upward from the base of the subject toward the top, revealing height

tilt_down.label: Tilt Down
tilt_down.prompt: the camera tilts downward from above toward the ground, settling on the subject

pan_left.label: Pan Left
pan_left.prompt: the camera pans smoothly to the left across the scene, revealing what was outside the frame

pan_right.label: Pan Right
pan_right.prompt: the camera pans smoothly to the right across the scene, revealing what was outside the frame

whip_pan.label: Whip Pan
whip_pan.prompt: the camera whip pans violently sideways, extreme horizontal motion blur smearing the entire frame
whip_pan.notes: Best used as a transition tail, not a whole shot. Generate it, then trim to the last ~0.4s.

fpv_drone.label: FPV Drone
fpv_drone.prompt: aggressive FPV drone shot flying fast through the scene, swooping and banking, dynamic first-person aerial motion, wide lens distortion
fpv_drone.notes: Loves environments and architecture. Hates close-ups of objects.

handheld.label: Handheld
handheld.prompt: handheld camera with natural human shake and micro-corrections, documentary feel, slight breathing motion
handheld.notes: The cheapest way to make a generated shot stop looking generated.

static.label: Locked Off
static.prompt: the camera is locked off on a tripod and does not move, completely static frame, only the subject moves
static.notes: Use when the motion should come from the subject, not the lens. Also the right pick when you plan to add a render-time zoom on top.

bullet_time.label: Bullet Time
bullet_time.prompt: extreme slow motion while the camera arcs rapidly around the frozen subject, bullet time effect, time nearly stopped
bullet_time.notes: Spectacular when it lands, incoherent when it doesn't. Budget rerolls.

rack_focus.label: Rack Focus
rack_focus.prompt: the lens racks focus from the blurred foreground to the sharp background, shallow depth of field shifting

time_lapse.label: Time Lapse
time_lapse.prompt: fast time lapse, clouds and light racing across the scene, long exposure trails, hours compressed into seconds

parallax_2d.label: 2.5D Parallax
parallax_2d.prompt: subtle three dimensional parallax as the camera drifts, foreground and background separating with depth, photo coming alive
parallax_2d.notes: The move that makes a still photograph read as footage. Best I2V preset on a static seed image.

style_suffix.description: Appended after the subject + camera fragments. Keeps output looking like footage rather than like a render.
style_suffix.cinematic: shot on film, cinematic color grading, natural lighting, shallow depth of field, 24fps motion cadence
style_suffix.documentary: documentary footage, available light, realistic texture, unpolished and candid
style_suffix.broadcast: clean broadcast television look, even lighting, high clarity, professional camera
style_suffix.gritty: grainy handheld footage, high contrast, harsh practical lighting, raw and unglamorous

negative_default: text, watermark, logo, subtitles, caption, distorted faces, extra limbs, warping geometry, flickering, blurry, low quality, jpeg artifacts, static noise, morphing objects
